name: VanguardVPS · Ubuntu SSH + 9router + Hermes Agent
description: Ubuntu 24.04 SSH VPS di Railway dengan Hermes Agent & 9router AI gateway. Akses root langsung. Setup AI di UI web 9router & Hermes Dashboard. Dev: TheFoolByte.
readme:
# VanguardVPS — Cloud AI Workspace

Ubuntu SSH + 9router + Hermes Agent di Railway. Klik Deploy, variabel boleh kosong.

Password default: `Vanguard123@`

- SSH TCP port 22
- 9router HTTP port 20128
- Hermes Dashboard port 8686
- Dual Auto-Backup: `GITHUB_TOKEN` + `GITHUB_REPO` / `HERMES_GITHUB_REPO`

Repo: https://github.com/TheFoolByte/RailDK

© VanguardVPS · TheFoolByte

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Password root + login dashboard 9router & Hermes. Kosong = Vanguard123@.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Token GitHub (scope repo). Wajib kalau mau backup. PAT: ghp_...

GITHUB_REPO.description: Repo backup: owner/name atau URL. Kosong = auto-buat vanguard-vps-src-<id>. Launch: restore sekali, lalu auto-backup.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key untuk root. Opsional. Password tetap aktif.

SSH_USERNAME.description: User sudo tambahan. Isi bareng SSH_PASSWORD.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password user sudo tambahan. Isi bareng SSH_USERNAME.

SYNC_INTERVAL.description: Jeda sync /root/src (detik). Hanya dipakai kalau GITHUB_TOKEN diisi.

HERMES_ENABLED.description: Aktifkan Hermes Agent CLI, Web Dashboard, dan Gateway.

HERMES_GITHUB_REPO.description: Repo privat backup Hermes (state.db, memory, config). Kosong = auto buat vanguard-vps-hermes-<id>.
